scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: Select a square support until intensity sum exceeds threshold; accumulate normalization, normalize image, average selected support
scientific_intent.accuracy_requirements: Exact support radius choices; finite normalization/output and unchanged absolute1e-3 error contract. Floatingatomic accumulation order may perturb normalized intensity.
scientific_intent.input_size_regime: Named128x128 image, threshold4000, maximumradius5; broadimages andrectangular grids notcertified
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: Threshold comparisons and Float32atomic normalization affect output; no conservation guarantee asserted
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Adaptive denoising of numerical image fields; illustrative community task, not an independently validated astronomical or medical application
scientific_intent.description: This benchmark performs adaptive smoothing on a numeric pixel field, increasing neighborhood support until a specified intensity sum is reached. Its scientific result includes the chosen support and normalized smoothed intensity, rather than merely a fixed-radius stencil.
scientific_intent.provenance: Native smoothingFilter/normalizeFilter/outFilter and reference.h establish the algorithm; application-specific provenance is not supplied. Domainclassification source-backed, communityusecase illustrative.
